defects.summary: The seven MOD-027 and MOD-028 Developer unit tests that Mike allowed the MOD-031 Developer to widen (answers.md, 'MOD-031 regression: older tests at the old grain', 2026-11-27) were not widened. They still seed silv_daily_count_detail at the pre-MOD-031 grain with no local_group_id, so the gold load fails on its staging table.
defects.steps_to_reproduce: Run run_suite on commit c5b77025e827. Each of the seven listed tests in test_MOD027_dev and test_MOD028_dev fails with the NULL local_group_id error in #det_stage. Each one fakes Layercake.silv_daily_count_detail, inserts rows without local_group_id, contact_country_id or contact_region, and calls Layercake.usp_load_fact_daily_member_count_detail.
defects.expected: The MOD-031 rework widens these seven tests, and changes only the grain, column lists or index they name. Seeded detail and fact rows carry local_group_id 0, contact_country_id = country_id and contact_region = region, as the answer says. The tests then pass against the MOD-031 build, which now keys gold on the ten-column grain (RULE-170 to RULE-179, REQ-027).
defects.actual: All seven fail at the gold daily fact load (usp_load_fact_daily_member_count_detail) with: "Cannot insert the value NULL into column 'local_group_id', table 'tempdb.dbo.#det_stage...'; column does not allow nulls." The faked silver detail rows these tests insert have no local_group_id. Every MOD-031 test condition passes (21/21), and so do the Developer's 8 MOD-031 unit tests. CN-MOD-031 does not list these seven tests as changed.
